entities.name: Mysticism & Esotericism
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: Spiritual traditions emphasizing direct, personal experience of the divine or ultimate reality, often through contemplative practices. From Sufi whirling and Kabbalistic meditation to Christian mysticism and Hindu yoga, esoteric traditions have offered alternative paths to knowledge beyond rational inquiry across all major civilizations.
